name: Camp Pasquaney
description_short: A seven-week overnight summer camp for boys ages 11 to 16 on Newfound Lake in Hebron, NH, founded in 1895. The 2027 season runs June 26 to August 15 and includes camping expeditions, a long hike, a theater play, crew races and a water sports weekend.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on a half mile of Newfound Lake shoreline. Each boy takes a series of swim tests; counsellors teach swimmers of all levels, and the diving raft has a springboard and a high dive.

warnings: The page doesn't explicitly say campers stay overnight. 'Sleepaway' is inferred from the full-summer season, Visiting Weekend and the 'Dorm Life' menu item.
Only one full-season tuition is listed ($11,725, about seven weeks). No weekly rate is given.
